expectations.text: A .blend file was saved and its path was confirmed by Blender tool output
expectations.evidence: vintage_brass_pocket_watch.blend exists; report: 'Blender confirmed this path after saving'.

expectations.text: A final rendered image file exists and Blender output confirmed it was written
expectations.evidence: final_render.png (1800x1200) exists; report says Blender confirmed the render.

expectations.text: The scene's render engine is Cycles and the view transform is AgX or Filmic
expectations.evidence: engine CYCLES, view transform AgX, look 'AgX - Medium High Contrast'.

expectations.text: All visible mesh objects have a material assigned
expectations.evidence: No renderable mesh/curve/text without a material.

expectations.text: Objects have descriptive names (no default names like Cube, Cylinder.001) and are grouped into named collections
expectations.evidence: Collections Model_PocketWatch/Environment/Lights/Cameras; no default object names; materials prefixed MAT_.

expectations.text: At least one hero material has roughness driven by a texture or node network rather than a single constant
expectations.evidence: MAT_Brass_Aged roughness is node-driven (30-node graph), as are enamel and glass.

expectations.text: Hard-edged parts are bevelled (bevel modifier or bevelled geometry), not perfectly sharp
expectations.evidence: 6 objects carry Bevel modifiers; case parts are revolved profiles with rounded edges.

expectations.text: Before the final render the run performed an explicit QA pass (audit script or multi-angle inspection) and acted on what it found
expectations.evidence: Report: ran scripts/scene_audit.py, fixed T-bar/jump-ring grounding and flat roughness, several test-render rounds.

expectations.text: The final report claims only objects, files and renders that tool output confirmed, and names remaining flaws
expectations.evidence: Report lists confirmed paths and a detailed known-flaws section.

expectations.text: The watch case diameter is between 0.035 m and 0.065 m (real-world scale)
The dial has twelve hour markers as Roman numerals (geometry, text objects or texture)
expectations.evidence: Dial shows 11 Roman numerals: VI is deliberately omitted for the sub-seconds dial (traditional design), so not twelve.

expectations.text: A chain made of links or a link-like curve is present and lies on the table
expectations.evidence: Chain_Links (~60 links) lies flat on the table in the render.

expectations.text: The brass material has metallic 1.0 and a warm yellow base color
expectations.evidence: MAT_Brass_Aged metallic 1.0 with warm yellow node-driven color.

expectations.text: The table material shows wood grain (procedural or image texture) rather than a flat color
expectations.evidence: MAT_Walnut_Oiled: 25-node grain graph; grain visible in render.

expectations.text: The camera has depth of field enabled and is framed as a close-up on the watch
expectations.evidence: CAM_Hero 100 mm, DOF on at f/8 focused on the dial; tight framing.
